name: Callum's dev tools (treehouse, Claude Code CLI) - DEPRECATED
description: DEPRECATED: use the dev-system base image ghcr.io/cbundy/dev-system/base instead (cbundy/dev-system#89). Installs the tooling behind Callum's dev flow: the treehouse worktree pool, and the Claude Code CLI. Installs run as the remote user at post-create time, so per-user tools land in the user's home exactly as a hand-run install would.

installClaudeCode.description: Install the Claude Code CLI globally via npm (requires a Node-capable base image).

installTreehouse.description: Install treehouse, the reusable worktree pool for parallel agents (binary release from kunchenguid/treehouse).
